campbell.summary: Campbell keeps it low-key this stretch: sketch the Water Tower alongside the Farmers Market Sunday morning, then catch Music & Movement Storytime or the ESL Conversation Club at Campbell Library Tuesday.

highlights.title: Campbell Water Tower & Farmers Market Sketch Walk

cupertino.summary: Cupertino kicks off the week with the Environmental Education Center Open House at McClellan Ranch Preserve and paper shredding at De Anza College, then the council meets Tuesday to recognize National Preparedness Month and National Hispanic Heritage Month.

highlights.title: Paper Shredding and Environmental Recycling
highlights.venue: De Anza College Parking Lot A

highlights.title: Recognition of Innovation & Technology Department (Applications, GIS, Infrastructure, Multimedia, and Administration Divisions)

los-gatos.summary: Los Gatos keeps it low-key this stretch: Sunday brings the Farmers Market at Town Park Plaza plus a morning walk to Manresa Bread from Oak Meadow Park, while the library hosts ESL Conversation Club and Social Stitching Monday.

highlights.title: Girl Scout Brownie Art and Design Badge

mountain-view.summary: Mountain View's long weekend spans a solo-travel talk at the library Saturday, a Verilog meetup at Hacker Dojo and park improv Sunday, plus a Bob Baker Marionette Theater Variety Show at Pioneer Park Monday.

highlights.title: How to Start Solo Traveling the World

saratoga.summary: Saturday brings the I Love The 90's Tour featuring Vanilla Ice, Young MC, C&C Music Factory and Tag Team to The Mountain Winery, plus the Saratoga Farmers Market at West Valley College, while Sunday's lineup pairs Diana Ross at the Winery with the library's Open Mic and Hidden Birdlife of Silicon Valley talk.

highlights.title: I Love The 90's Tour feat. Vanilla Ice with Young Mc, C&C Music Factory featuring Freedom Williams, Tag Team

sunnyvale.summary: Sunnyvale's Lakewood Branch Library and Learning Center celebrates its grand opening and an art project Saturday, while the Farmers Market runs on Murphy Avenue and the city gathered input on the 1250 Oakmead Parkway housing project's environmental review Monday.

highlights.title: Art Opening & Community Art Project at Lakewood Branch Library
highlights.venue: Lakewood Branch Library and Learning Center

highlights.title: Lakewood Branch Library and Learning Center Grand Opening
highlights.venue: Lakewood Branch Library and Learning Center

highlights.title: Public meeting on Oakmead Parkway housing project's environmental review

san-jose.summary: Saturday brings Adopt-a-Storm Drain Community Day at Penitencia Creek Park and Chicano Soul Fest 2026 at History Park, while Tuesday's council agenda takes up affordable housing financing and the Arena Hotel Redevelopment's Homekey Program transition.

highlights.title: Amendment to the Contract with the California Public Employees’ Retirement System (CalPERS) to Allow Employees in the Deputy Chief Investment Officer Classification in the Office of Retirement Services to Enroll in CalPERS Retirement Benefits

santa-clara.summary: Usher and Chris Brown close out The R&B Tour's second Santa Clara show at Levi's Stadium Saturday, while the city hosts a free residential compost giveaway at the Dept. of Public Works Corporation Yard the same morning.

highlights.title: Usher & Chris Brown - The R&B Tour (Second Show)
Residential Compost Giveaway
highlights.venue: Dept. of Public Works Corporation Yard

los-altos.summary: Los Altos Library hosts Monday Morning Meditation & Mindfulness on Monday, while Sunday brings Train Day, a storytime with Jerrold Connors, and Art in the Garden at Hidden Villa for those wanting an early-week wind-down after a family-packed weekend.

palo-alto.summary: Palo Alto's weekend runs from the Downtown Farmers' Market on Gilman Street Saturday morning to Sunday's Mitchell Park Library lineup, including a photography meetup and the Iranian dance program "Clap, Step, Connect."

highlights.title: Downtown Palo Alto Farmers' Market
highlights.venue: Gilman Street between Hamilton and Forest

milpitas.summary: Milpitas Library keeps busy this stretch — a discussion on global warming Sunday, a free adult ESL class Monday, plus baby lapsit and K-6 homework help Tuesday, while Peter T. Gill Park hosts calisthenics Monday evening.
